'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Barry Alperstein LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Barry Alperstein]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation]]
* '''Username:''' MrFromMars
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
